draft.heroMessage: Trusted expertise in Mount Snow & Southern Vermont real estate.
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! I’m Adam Palmiter, proud to call Southern Vermont home since 1985. Let me help you discover your perfect four-season getaway.
draft.tagline: Southern Vermont’s go-to agent for personalized, professional results.
draft.aboutParagraph: Having called the Mount Snow region home for most of my life, I combine deep local knowledge with proven marketing, negotiation, and client service. Since 2004, I’ve helped buyers and sellers from country estates to ski condos navigate Southern Vermont real estate. Whether you’re searching for your first country home, that once-in-a-lifetime lakefront escape, or the ideal trailside condo, I offer dedicated guidance from first handshake to closing—and beyond. My commitment to clients extends to charitable work in our community and building trusted relationships that last long after the sale.
draft.conciergeLine: Curious about Mount Snow or looking for honest local advice? Reach out—my years of experience are at your service.
draft.contactLine: Ready to start your Vermont real estate journey? Call, text, or email me anytime.
draft.tone: Warm, knowledgeable, and accessible with a personal and community-focused touch.

Having called the Mount Snow region home for most of my life, I combine deep local knowledge with proven marketing, negotiation, and client service.
